routes.content: S2b plus, per SEL: 100 kOhm series RC0603FR-07100KL and BAT54S,215 (pin 3 = SEL, pin 2 = +12 V, pin 1 = AGND)

TMUX6112_row.basis: Under definition 1 the clamp current is <= 0.008 mA, so SEL <= VDD + 240 mV maximum (BAT54S VF at 0.1 mA, 25 C). Unsequenced with +5 V at the PROPOSED 5.5 V ceiling: <= 0.055 mA, also inside the 0.1 mA row. Both stay below VDD + 0.3 V.
open: BAT54S VF has no maximum away from 25 C (fact-clamp-diode-forward-voltage-temperature); the 60 mV margin at cold is UNKNOWN
Both BAT54S diodes leak <= 2 uA each at 25 V: <= 0.40 V drop in 100 kOhm, plus 1.6 % into the 6 MOhm typical pull-down; SEL high stays about 4.5 V at +5 V, above VIH 2 V
Series RC with the SEL and diode capacitance adds roughly microsecond delay; envelope clock is 50 us; not simulated
Board K placement and the #293 fill/DRC would need a rerun
